title: DiagnosticEvent
description: One diagnostic event about the stack's own behavior: a session, a headless run, a gate verdict, a sprint evaluation, a compaction, a projection-cost measurement, a retrieval miss. Written by the council's SessionEnd hook (.council/diagnostics.jsonl), derived by the archivist from auto-mate run records, and copied into index/diagnostics/events-<YYYY-MM>.jsonl. Never contains prompt or response bodies. See decisions/ADR-0006-diagnostics.md.

event_id.description: UUID; the deduplication key when events are copied into the index.

ts.description: When the measured thing ended, UTC.

project.description: Repository name as listed in workspace/repos.json.

session_id.description: Claude Code session id; the join key across audit entries, transcripts, run records and OTel.

parent_session_id.description: For a headless crew or gate: the session that invoked automate, when known.

run_path.description: Path of the persisted run record this event was derived from.

sprint.description: Sprint context at the time, from .harness/sprint-state.json.

agent_name.description: Subagent or gate name when the event is about one agent.

head.description: Commit sha at the end of the measured thing.

usage_by_model.description: Per-model totals; keys are model ids.

sidechain_usage.description: The share of usage attributable to subagents (transcript entries with isSidechain true).

cost_source.description: claude-code-estimate: total_cost_usd reported by claude -p; price-table: computed from tokens and a price table; backend: from the OTel backend or Console.

outcome.description: Terminal state in the producer's own vocabulary: shipped, gated, no_changes, failed for runs; PASS, FAIL, PARTIAL for sprint evals; VERDICT: PASS or FAIL for gates; ended, interrupted for sessions.

labels.description: Free-form string labels: cynefin, loop_shape, rubric, project_type, crew_backend, permission_mode, claude_code_version, trigger (scheduled or manual).

summary.description: Optional one-line human note. Never a prompt or a response.
